commit.message:
Release v1.5.3 with static HUD protection and fullscreen Auto recovery.

Static UI keeps a 4px halo, Auto no longer idles the GPU because of upscale or a paused sample, and entering or leaving fullscreen no longer pins playback at the source rate.

Release v1.5.3 with static HUD protection and fullscreen Auto recovery.

Static UI keeps a 4px halo, Auto no longer idles the GPU because of upscale or a paused sample, and entering or leaving fullscreen no longer pins playback at the source rate.

Release v1.5.4: fix static-guard pan ghosting and scene-cut recovery

fix(runtime): gate the static guard by motion. The 1.5.0 wHalo term engaged
the guard near flat-colour regions regardless of motion, blending panning
content toward the unwarped frame average and doubling/ghosting moving line
art (anime pans). wStatic is now scaled by (1 - smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, motion)),
so static text stays protected at motion~0 while moving content is left to the
interpolation. Mirrored into web/rt/rt.js.

fix(extension): recover smoothly from hard scene cuts. Bridge the just-captured
frame's presentation slot across a confirmed rate-plan transition (it was
dropped with the in-flight pair decision), and pad the presentation delay by a
fast-attack/slow-decay lateness tail so delivery bursts are pre-buffered instead
of becoming a ~0.5s drop burst.

feat(extension): add a Flow upsample mode (edge/gate/bilinear) for the texture
flow-upsample path; default edge keeps current behaviour.
